name: shiny-button
title: Shiny Button
description: Two dark outline buttons in a card whose labels and edges catch a soft light band that keeps travelling across them, giving a quiet metallic shimmer.
use: A primary call to action should shimmer subtly instead of shouting with colour.
avoid: Pages with many buttons; the looping shine becomes noisy when repeated.
a11y: It is a real button with a text label, but the looping shine ignores reduced-motion and there is no custom focus style. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark card holds a white heading, a short grey line of text, and two side-by-side pill buttons with thin light borders. Each button carries a small, widely spaced uppercase label in a muted tone.
behaves: A narrow light band slides across each label and around the border, pauses, then sweeps again in a loop. A button also casts a faint glow on hover and dips in size when pressed.
customise: Pass the label as children and add classes; the sweep timing, spring and border mask are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A small mask sweep loops over a couple of buttons; nothing heavy runs.
